title: Runtime: add feature flag + config plumbing for KV cache compaction/eviction (default off)
author: Benji Okafor
release_notes:
- Adds runtime config schema for KV cache compaction/eviction modes (default disabled).
- Adds guardrails/validation for budgets + safe defaults.
- Documents flags inline in `runtime/config/README.md` and config schema comments.
- No behavior change unless explicitly enabled via config/flag.
description:
Context: This PR wires up runtime configuration + feature flags needed to safely roll out KV cache compaction/eviction work behind a gate. The allocator/compaction engine is landing in adjacent PRs; this change focuses on the configuration surface area, schema validation, and making sure the default behavior is unchanged (compaction disabled; eviction policy remains existing behavior unless mode is selected). Motivation: SRE needs an oncall-safe set of toggles for canary (region/pool scoped) with hard guardrails, and runtime needs a stable config contract for scheduler integration and perf-canary gating.

What’s in this PR: Adds new config section `kv_cache` with subkeys for `compaction` and `eviction`. Implements config parsing + validation, including sane defaults and upper bounds for budgets. Adds a FeatureFlag gate `runtime.kv_cache_compaction` (wired into existing flag evaluation) with explicit precedence rules: (1) global feature flag must be enabled, (2) config `kv_cache.compaction.enabled` must be true, (3) runtime must pass basic safety checks (GPU supports async copy path; build has compaction compiled in). Adds an enum `eviction_mode` to allow controlled selection (e.g., `legacy`, `tier_aware_v1`) but keeps default `legacy`. Adds in-code docs for each knob and a short `runtime/config/README.md` section with rollout guidance (what to toggle, safe ranges, and what metrics to watch). This PR intentionally does not change allocator behavior by default.

Config keys added (summary): `kv_cache.compaction.enabled` (bool, default false); `kv_cache.compaction.trigger_fragmentation_ratio` (float, default 0.35); `kv_cache.compaction.budget_ms_per_s` (int, default 2; clamped 0..10); `kv_cache.compaction.max_bytes_per_interval` (int, default 268435456); `kv_cache.eviction.mode` (string enum, default legacy); `kv_cache.eviction.pressure_high_watermark` (float, default 0.92); `kv_cache.eviction.pressure_low_watermark` (float, default 0.85). Precedence: if flag disabled, compaction is forced off regardless of config, and metrics/logs will annotate `compaction_state=flag_off`.

Notes for rollout: This is intended for ENG-2851 canary. Region/pool scoping is supported via the existing runtime config overlay system; no new rollout system is introduced here.

Testing: Adds unit tests for parsing/validation (bounds, enum values, precedence), and a small integration smoke test verifying defaults do not enable compaction and do not touch eviction mode.

Follow-ups: ENG-2847 (triggers/budget enforcement) will consume these fields; ENG-2850 (dashboards) will alert off `compaction_state` and budget utilization; scheduler hook PR will use the eviction pressure watermarks.

Snippet (illustrative): `kv_cache: { compaction: { enabled: false, budget_ms_per_s: 2, trigger_fragmentation_ratio: 0.35 }, eviction: { mode: legacy, pressure_high_watermark: 0.92, pressure_low_watermark: 0.85 } }`
commits: runtime/config: add kv_cache compaction + eviction schema + defaults
runtime/flags: add runtime.kv_cache_compaction feature gate and precedence rules
runtime/config: validation + clamping for compaction budgets and watermarks
docs(runtime): document KV cache compaction/eviction knobs and rollout guidance
tests: config parsing/validation coverage for kv_cache section
conversation:
Omar El-Sayed (review): Can we make sure the default is hard-off even if someone sets config enabled by mistake? I want the feature flag to be a strict gate during canary so we can centrally disable. Benji Okafor (author): Yep—flag is strict gate; config only takes effect if flag on. I added a `compaction_state` annotation for observability (`flag_off`, `config_off`, `enabled`).

Sofia Ivanova (review): Please document precedence clearly; scheduler integration will rely on eviction mode not silently changing. Also, the watermark names should match the scheduler signal naming. Benji Okafor: Updated README + schema comments; renamed internal fields to `pressure_high_watermark/pressure_low_watermark` and added a mapping note for scheduler.

Sean Gallagher (SRE review): Need guardrails: budget upper bound, and a way to set budget=0 without disabling compaction entirely (for debugging). Also prefer an explicit rollback lever. Benji Okafor: Added clamping 0..10 ms/s; budget=0 keeps compaction enabled but effectively idle (still reports state). Rollback lever is flipping the global flag; config overlays remain but are ignored when flag off.

Allison Grant (observability): Please standardize the tag/key names used in logs/metrics. We’re going to build alerts on it. Benji Okafor: Added `compaction_state` and `eviction_mode` fields to structured runtime config dump; included in schema docs. (Metric emission itself is in PR-18423; this PR only ensures consistent strings.)

Grace Kim (kernel safety): Any chance this config changes kernel path selection by accident? Benji Okafor: No—this PR doesn’t call into kernel selection. Only stores options; compaction execution is elsewhere and gated.

CI: Initial run failed config-schema-validate due to missing docstrings; fixed in commit `docs(runtime): document KV cache ...` and reran.

Approval: Omar approved after precedence change; Sean approved after clamping; Sofia approved after naming cleanup.

Merge: Squash merged to main; Connor O’Brien queued for next runtime release train. Notes left for canary checklist to use `runtime.kv_cache_compaction` as the primary lever.
